stories.title: Recall Alert: Primark's 101 Dalmatians Coin Purses Contain Toxic Chemicals

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text: RECALL: ~2,100 Primark 101 Dalmatians kids coin purses recalled 10/15. Phthalate levels too high — harmful to young children. Model No. 2595301, sold Mar–Jun 2026 ~$9. Return to Primark for full refund. Stop use now. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
